title: Eliminate durable /wc bootstrap-version drift
problem: The active public and main /wc bootstrap is v3.3, while CONTINUITY_HEAD.json and FOCUS.json still describe the mass-launch worker canary as v3.1. Fresh workers are told to load those durable projections during L0 activation, so the same worker can observe contradictory bootstrap-version claims before allocation. The stale projections are pointers rather than authority, but the contradiction increases reconstruction cost and can make future workers reason from an obsolete capability surface.
mission: Repair the durable bootstrap-version projections and prevent recurrence by binding worker-canary version references to exact bootstrap evidence or by marking them freshness-bounded/derived. Preserve authority semantics: this work must not promote /wc to production /w or infer operational capability from version agreement alone.
acceptance: continuity head and focus no longer advertise stale wc version
exact evidence shows active wc version and durable projections agree
runtime/bootstrap version references are derived or explicitly freshness-bounded to prevent recurrence

goal_relevance.reason: Fresh identical /wc workers should reconstruct one coherent durable posture before autonomous allocation; contradictory bootstrap versions weaken that contract.

information_gain.reason: Makes version provenance explicit instead of forcing each worker to infer which of public bootstrap, main bootstrap, head and focus is newer.

regression_prevention.reason: A derived or freshness-bounded version reference prevents future bootstrap edits from silently leaving continuity projections behind.

human_friction_reduction.reason: Reduces the need for the human or guide to explain why a fresh worker sees v3.3 at entry but v3.1 in durable state.

candidate_write_scope: the exact compiler/generator path proven to own worker-canary version projection
falsification: CONTINUITY_HEAD.json and FOCUS.json already resolve worker-canary version dynamically from the exact current /wc bytes rather than storing v3.1 as durable text.
The v3.1 references are intentionally historical fields with explicit timestamp/freshness semantics and cannot be consumed as current bootstrap metadata.
Updating or deriving the references would cross a promotion/authority boundary rather than correcting a projection inconsistency.

source_freshness.observed_public_bootstrap: PROMETEO UNIVERSAL COGNITIVE WORKER CANARY v3.3
source_freshness.observed_main_bootstrap: PROMETEO UNIVERSAL COGNITIVE WORKER CANARY v3.3
source_freshness.observed_durable_projection: CONTINUITY_HEAD.json and FOCUS.json still reference /wc v3.1

risk.main: Blindly replacing version strings would fix the symptom while allowing the projection to drift again.
risk.mitigation: First identify the generator/owner of the projected field; then derive or freshness-bound it and test a future bootstrap-version mismatch fixture.
